title: Don John of Austria to the Spanish ambassadors in Genoa, Namur, 6 and 7 August 1577 (catalogue 753, AGS Estado 1410,77 and 1410,135): cipher copies whose contemporary decipherments are filed apart (1410,111 and 1410,110); 1577 Genoa-embassy key validated on the fresh pair 1410,135/110

documents.route: Don John of Austria, governor general of the Netherlands -> Juan de Idiáquez and Pedro de Mendoza, Spanish ambassadors in Genoa (cipher copy)

plaintext.source: AGS Estado 1410,110 (PARES 3577630), "Copia de carta de Juan de Austria ... sobre la toma de Charleroi", Namur 7 Aug 1577: the contemporary decipherment, filed as a separate item and not linked to 1410,135 by PARES. Transcribed here as plaintext_1410_110.txt.

transcription.notes: Cipher body only (15 lines; the 4-line cipher heading was decoded by eye to identify the letter and is left out). 247 syllabic units (number + vowel mark + finals), 86 distinct unit forms on 27 base numbers. Two passes (line crops at 2-3x; then half-line strips at 2.5x with contrast), settled on the image; 8 doubtful signs listed in the file header.

plaintext.source: AGS Estado 1410,111 (PARES 3577649), "Copia de carta descifrada del Sr don Juan para los embaxadores de Genova ... del castillo de Namur a 6 de agosto 1577", 3 pp.; incipit "Son tan varios los successos de por aca", explicit "de lo que sucediere les avisare" = first and last words of 1410,77. Not linked by PARES.

transcription.notes: Transcribed in full (84 lines, 1,713 units) by Brice Dudout's agents in Oct 2026; not included here because the letter is read from its contemporary decipherment. Used only as learning data for the key (lines 1-24 and page 3, lines 1-20, against 1410,111).

system.summary: The 1577 numerical syllabary of the Spanish embassy at Genoa (as in targets/perez1578 and targets/idiaquez1577), in the hand of the copies made for Don John: a number is a consonant (6 d, 7 c, 8 b, 11 g, 12 h, 14 gu, 15 l, 16 m, 17 n, 20 p, 21 qu, 22 r, 23 s, 24 t, 25 v, 27 x, 28 y, 30 br, 33 fr, 35 pr, 36 tr), a mark after it is the vowel (cross a, dot e, 6-loop i, hook o, long-s mark o in 1410,77), the bare numbers 10, 4, 2, 18, 1 are vowels, marks above or a bar add n, s, r or l; letter groups and crossed numbers are nomenclator entries (in 1410,77: gil estados, xil gente, pam nuestro, hom marques, 1008+ successos ...).
system.notes: Homophones seen: vowels 10/9 a, 4/3 e, 1/0 u in 1410,77. Values that differ by hand: 26 is v in 1410,77 but fi in 1410,135 (firme), and 8 is b here but g in Pérez's hand. A digit 3 with a loop above stands for the numeral three (tres dias).

prior_solution.where: AGS Estado 1410,111 (decipherment of 1410,77) and 1410,110 (decipherment of 1410,135), filed as separate items in the same legajo; neither is linked to its cipher in PARES. No edition found.

conditions.human_role: Brice Dudout chose the catalogue rows and set the rules (frozen key, one held-out measurement, 200 controls); AI agents found the decipherments, transcribed, built and froze the key and ran the test. No human palaeographer checked the transcription.

solution.what: PARES full-text search "copia de carta de Juan de Austria": 1410,111 (decipherment of 1410,77, 6 Aug 1577) and 1410,110 (decipherment of the 7 Aug letter) found, neither linked to a cipher.

The Genoa 1577 key (K5, validated on the pair 1410,78/79: 87.3% words, 95.5% characters) adapted to the hand of 1410,77 on 1410,77 lines 1-24 against 1410,111; held-out 1410,77 page 3 against 1410,111 page 3: 57.9% words, 72.7% characters, 200 controls at most 27.1 / 49.2 (old transcription at 1011 px).

Key extended on the already-used 77/111 data only (xil gente, sim mente, pam nuestro, pam+ nuestra, yum+ otra, 26 = v, bare 6 = i) and frozen (key_frozen.json, SHA-256 in key_frozen.sha256) before 1410,135 was transcribed.

1410,135 found to be the cipher of 1410,110 from its cipher heading ("copia de carta del señor [don Juan] para los embaxadores de Genova del castillo de Namur a 7 de agosto 1577"). Body transcribed in two passes and frozen (SHA-256 3558ee69...) before 1410,110 was opened.

One measurement, scripts/heldout.py: frozen key on 1410,135 against 1410,110 = 80.2% of 106 words, 89.2% of 437 characters; 200 controls (100 permuted consonant values, 100 shuffled unit orders) at most 18.9% / 47.8%. Criterion written beforehand (characters >= 0.85 and >= best control + 0.30): met.

The decryption follows 1410,110 word for word; the misses are signs of the copy (26 = fi here, 14 written with a cross, an+ for on) and words the cipher has and the decipherment drops ("que cada dia" before "se ofrecen").

outcome.method_basis: Both letters are read in their contemporary decipherments (1410,111 and 1410,110); the key of the Genoa 1577 syllabary in the copyist's hand was rebuilt on 1410,77/111 and checked on the fresh pair 1410,135/110.
outcome.notes: Catalogue 753 lists 1410,77 and 1410,135 as open ciphertexts; both have contemporary decipherments filed apart in the same legajo (1410,111 and 1410,110). The 7 Aug letter: Don John expects Charlemont (Charleroi in PARES) to fall to the States, plans to take it by a deal within three days and then to wait there with a German garrison, unless those of Luxembourg force him elsewhere; plans change from hour to hour.

credits.note: decipherments found and matched to the cipher copies 1410,77 and 1410,135; key adapted and validated; transcription of 1410,135
